panels.title: F09 recorded flight route (GPS, every 10th sample) and landing position

targets.rawSql: SELECT vehicle_id, latitude_deg AS latitude, longitude_deg AS longitude FROM f09_flight_analytics_v1.gps_v1 WHERE latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT vehicle_id, latitude_deg AS latitude, longitude_deg AS longitude FROM f09_flight_analytics_v1.gps_v1 WHERE source_ordinal % 10 = 0 AND latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source_ordinal

panels.description: Historical F09 route from receiver-reported GPS, every 10th source ordinal, and the last recorded position. No map tiles are loaded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT gps_utc AS time, ground_speed_m_s AS speed FROM f09_flight_analytics_v1.gps_v1 WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND gps_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(gps_utc) ORDER BY gps_utc

panels.title: GPS altitude above mean sea level (m)

targets.rawSql: SELECT gps_utc AS time, altitude_msl_m AS altitude FROM f09_flight_analytics_v1.gps_v1 WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND gps_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(gps_utc) ORDER BY gps_utc

panels.title: Battery voltage (V)
panels.description: Research association, GPS UTC display axis; unmatched positions are null. Not a battery measurement-time or safety claim.

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.gps_utc AS time, if(m.status = 'matched', b.voltage_v, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64))) AS value FROM f09_flight_analytics_v1.gps_v1 AS g INNER JOIN f09_battery_research_v1.gps_battery_match_v1 AS m ON g.event_id = m.gps_event_id LEFT JOIN f09_battery_research_v1.battery_v1 AS b ON m.battery_event_id = b.event_id WHERE g.vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND g.gps_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(g.gps_utc) ORDER BY g.gps_utc SETTINGS join_use_nulls=1
